notes.title: Launch Day Patch
notes.notes:
We've patched a few game breaking bugs found at the last second!


Fixed Computer-Pause Menu Softlock
Fixed Missing Transitions
Fixed Invisible Enemies
Fixed UI Distortion with Resolution Scaling
Fixed UI Button Hitboxes
Fixed Missing Lighting on Tuesday Night
